scope: One isolated Gemini source-grounded semantic extraction experiment
selection: Metadata only before outcomes: include all true-chain members, fill eight clear per language prioritizing two independent seeds, then first two ambiguous and two unsupported per language by ID. Reserve one non-chain clear and one unsupported per language for final confirmation.
freeze: Implementation worker does not read fresh corpus/gold/results. Freeze runtime/prompt/schema/value rules and fresh sample before one pass. No tuning against outputs. Fresh annotations are independent agent labels, not external human annotation.
comparison: Reuse canonicalInterpretation; source IDs ignored, Boolean scope, modality, exact values, transition targets and resulting plans retained. Report resulting-plan equality separately.
chains: Actual accepted state flows to the next turn; refusal preserves actual prior state. Never substitute gold. All chain members must be selected.
limitations: Small constructed diagnostic, not production certification. Token admission is an estimate; actual provider usage and finite reservations are checked. Jev/search/cloud serving remain outside this test.
